purpose: Replay the exposed November 5 static matrix experiment through the portable research implementation; no new holdout or quality admission.
split: Hash subjects for the 100 cold users. For each regular user, hash unique item IDs: first floor(70%) train, next to floor(85%) validation, remainder test. For held-out users, last 20% by the same hash are fixed targets; the first 80% are eligible visible evidence. No source times are fabricated.
scaleTransform: twice original rating; preserve original value; no observed zeros

modelDefinitions.global-mean: Mean of permitted global training labels
modelDefinitions.item-mean: (training item sum + 10 * global mean) / (training item count + 10)
modelDefinitions.profile-offset: Clipped item mean plus sum of visible user residuals against frozen training item means divided by (visible count + 10)

selection: Select lowest validation RMSE once; declared model order breaks ties. Save selection before reading test ratings for scoring. No tuning after test.
coldEvidenceMeaning: Number of visible rating records, never an allowed grade list; hash order is a diagnostic mask and not real history
admission: NONE; descriptive isolated pilot only, not a second final selection or production promotion
